messages.sourceEnglish: Confirm a mapped site’s country before using its crop-planning guidance.
messages.text: Netefatsa naha ea sebaka se mmepiloeng pele u sebelisa tataiso ea sona ea moralo oa lijalo.

messages.sourceEnglish: Keep your sowing records and nursery equipment while local planning is unavailable.
messages.text: Boloka lirekoto tsa hao tsa ho jala le lisebelisoa tsa nesari ea limela ha moralo oa sebaka o ntse o sa fumanehe.
Netefatsa naha ea sebaka sa hao

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Site country and region
messages.text: Moralo oa lijalo → Naha ea sebaka le lebatowa

messages.sourceEnglish: Open your mapped site and confirm its country details. Country confirmation does not approve farming advice for a new region.
messages.text: Bula sebaka sa hao se mmepiloeng mme u netefatse lintlha tsa naha ea sona. Ho netefatsa naha ha ho lumelle keletso ea temo bakeng sa lebatowa le letšha.

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Planning without a mapped site
messages.text: Moralo oa lijalo → Ho rera ntle le sebaka se mmepiloeng

messages.sourceEnglish: For a virtual bed or local design, explicitly choose or remove the South African reference basis. The choice stays with that workspace.
messages.text: Bakeng sa bethe e bōpiloeng kapa moralo oa sebaka, khetha kapa u tlose motheo oa tšupiso oa Afrika Boroa ka ho hlaka. Khetho ena e sala le sebaka seo sa mosebetsi.
